items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Cab had his self between us both, “C’mon Dorothy, C’mon Gene.”

ctx.x: I was playing opposite Gene Rodgers, who was a great pianist. And Cab had his self between us both, “C’mon Dorothy, C’mon Gene.” And he was shaking his hair. That’s what he contributed. We were doing the playing and he was shaking his hair.
Do you think you portrayed yourself well on film? Did your talent as a recording artist and as a stage artist transfer well to the screen?
